questiondescription.text:
Sets: regions of a two-set Venn diagram

Grade 12 CBE Core and Essential 1.1 (d): Describe sets built from two sets with union, intersection, complement and difference by listing their regions in a numbered Venn diagram.

Core and Essential

This question is adapted from the revision exercise on page 83, question 7 of School Mathematics Project, SMP Book 4 (Metric), ed. P. G. Bowie, Cambridge University Press, 1969: shading sets built from two sets on a Venn diagram; region numbers make the shading a typed set, and every expression is new.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
